scenario: [LGRA.2.9.6.4] — each timestamp directive rendered, as text. The pattern is resolved by the compiler into a TimePrim of fields and literal text (RLOW.6.4) and rendered by the runtime: libds's `render_time` here, Mercury's through the runtime differential. Fact 1 is 1234567890.123456789 s after the epoch, 2009-02-13T23:31:30Z: `%f` is `123456`, the nanoseconds TRUNCATED where rounding would give `123457`. Fact 2 is one nanosecond before the epoch: every field floors, to 1969-12-31T23:59:59.999999. A Time read from a slot is UTC ([LTIM.1.1.3]), so `%z` is `+0000` in both; an offset with a seconds part or a fraction needs `local()` and a timezone callback this harness does not configure, and is not reached here. The last line is one pattern mixing directives and literal text.
rules_ds:
schema E scope logical:
    id: Int key
    t: Time mutable

rule show:
    E e
->
    log critical "Y={e.t:%Y} m={e.t:%m} d={e.t:%d} H={e.t:%H} M={e.t:%M} S={e.t:%S} f={e.t:%f} z={e.t:%z} pct={e.t:%%}"
    log critical "iso=[{e.t:%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f%z}]"
